K01.drivers: Average proportions, normal shoulder-to-hip ratio, straight legs, ordinary profile curve with normal buttock and chest depth

K02.drivers: Typical slim-average human build, smooth joint transitions, normal profile

K03.drivers: Average human with slight belly and slightly broader torso; everything else ordinary

K04.drivers: Narrow pinched waist under a deep, rounded barrel-like chest/upper back that bulges both front and back in profile; very thin limbs with knobby, prominent knee joints and abrupt segment transitions; body reads as structurally different rather than just thin
axial_cues: deep rounded thorax bulging fore and aft in profile

K05.drivers: Same pattern as K04: barrel thorax with rounded back hump in profile, narrow waist, thin limbs, bulging knee/calf profile with zig-zag leg contour

K06.drivers: Ordinary slim-average human proportions and profile

K07.drivers: Extremely broad blocky trunk with very short legs, huge forearms and hands, massive feet, wide stance; leg profile shows bent knee with large forward calf mass; overall segment proportions (short legs, long heavy arms, giant extremities) beyond human muscular variation

K08.drivers: Somewhat broad torso with slight belly and deeper trunk, but within ordinary human range

K09.drivers: Same body type as K07, even more extreme: very wide trunk, enormous arms with big hands, short bowed legs, massive feet, flexed knee in profile

K11.drivers: Ordinary human proportions, slightly broader shoulders

groups.label: massive brute race: wide trunk, short bent legs, giant hands/feet

distinguishing_features: K07/K09 are enormously wide and bulky with short flexed legs, huge forearms, hands and feet (brute/ogre-like). K04/K05 are slender-limbed with a deep rounded thorax and back hump over a pinched waist and knobby knees; they are lighter than ordinary humans, not heavier. The two groups are easy to tell apart in both the grey and silhouette views. K04/K05 are the less certain call: they could possibly be read as very thin humans (B), but the structure of the thorax and knees points to a different body plan.
